label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Not counted: our safety guard refused the guest checkout button because its name looked like a sign-in action, a fault on our side, not the shop's.

reclassified.why: our safety guard refused the guest checkout button because its name looked like a sign-in action, a fault on our side, not the shop's.

findings.problem: The country picker opened as a blocking dialog in [name] (heading and buttons [name], [name]) although the page is in [name]. [name] is plain text, not a button, and Escape did not close it, so the only way out was to pick a country and press [name].

Size list changed after my first click: it first showed US sizes, then showed numbers 30 to 46, and the label said Size 10 for option 36. The first size choice was lost and Add to Bag said Please select a size, so the size scale was confusing and unreliable.

The first Add to Bag click did nothing visible except a Please select a size text; the basket count stayed 0. The Added to basket notice with a Checkout link disappeared before I could use it (click timed out), so I had to open the basket manually.

The guest checkout radio has a long accessible name that includes the words sign in later, and the Guest and Sign in options are plain radios with no button to continue. I could not select guest checkout: a click on the full name was refused, and shorter names, keyboard Space and [name] did nothing or timed out. There is no visible Continue button after the radios.
